Shipping a launch directory on Cloudflare alone

Sep 8, 2026#cloudflare#launches

A launch directory needs exactly three things a static site cannot do: count a view, take an upvote, and rank the list. Virga does all three in one public Worker over D1, keyed on a daily visitor fingerprint that never identifies a person.

// one upvote per visitor per slug, per day
POST /v1/reactions/launches/acme { "kind": "upvote" }

The ranking reads two small totals tables and never scans reactions.
